sections.title: Services, equipment and agreed price
sections.text: The exact approved quote identified in this document is part of this agreement. It identifies the installation location, service scope, quantities, included equipment and materials, exclusions and total agreed price. Home2Smart will perform that approved scope. The deposit is 25% of the total, rounded up to the nearest cent; the remaining agreed balance is due after installation, subject to the existing completion and payment-verification requirements. Payment does not waive cancellation rights. Additional work, substitutions, scope changes or additional charges require the customer's documented approval before that work or charge. An approval does not remove any cancellation rights that apply to the changed transaction.

sections.title: 1-Year Workmanship Guarantee
sections.text:
Home2Smart stands behind the quality of our installation services.

If a problem occurs within 12 months after installation because of our workmanship, we'll correct the covered installation problem at no additional charge.

This includes improperly installed TV mounts, improperly mounted cameras, installation-related cable or connection problems, incorrect initial device setup, and installation materials that fail because of improper selection or installation.

This guarantee does not cover manufacturer defects, unrelated equipment failures, internet or third-party service interruptions, normal wear, pre-existing property conditions, or damage resulting from unauthorized adjustments, modifications, or work performed by others.

These exclusions do not remove Home2Smart's responsibility for damage directly caused by our negligent installation or limit any rights customers have under applicable law.

sections.title: Requesting workmanship service
sections.text: The 12-month workmanship period begins on the recorded installation-completion date, not the quote, signature or deposit date. To request service, contact the seller using the telephone number or mailing address in this document. Provide your name, installation address, approximate completion date and a description of the problem; photos are helpful but are not required to make a request. Home2Smart will arrange a reasonable assessment and, for covered workmanship, corrective service at no additional charge. Please provide reasonable access. Report an immediate safety concern promptly and avoid using affected equipment when unsafe. A report or request does not waive statutory rights. This is not a lifetime warranty or a promise of unlimited equipment replacement.

sections.title: Scheduling and property access
sections.text: Installation requires a customer-approved appointment and reasonable access to the installation location. Tell Home2Smart about known mounting obstacles, concealed utilities, fragile surfaces, access restrictions and other known property conditions. The assessment does not assume undisclosed conditions are safe or included. Home2Smart will discuss any necessary scope change and obtain documented customer approval before additional work or charges. No installation, assignment or performance is authorized during an applicable mandatory cancellation period merely because an appointment, deposit or checkbox exists. This agreement contains no automatic emergency exception or cancellation-rights waiver.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
sections.text: Your statutory cancellation rights are preserved. The separate cancellation notices and the statement next to the signature explain the applicable cooling-off right. For this nonproduction North Carolina residential home-solicitation implementation, the transaction is treated as covered; no exception is assumed. A valid cancellation may be expressed in another written notice and need not use our form. Deposits are not automatically nonrefundable. Home2Smart will honor a valid cancellation and return payments within the legally required period; the notice states the applicable refund obligations. After any statutory period, contact Home2Smart to discuss cancellation or rescheduling. No cancellation charge is established by this draft; any lawful charge would require a separately documented agreement. Nothing in this agreement limits cancellation rights arising from missing or noncompliant required notices.

sections.title: Customer records and additional rights
sections.text: You receive the exact quote, service agreement, two completed cancellation-notice copies, electronic-record disclosure and signature evidence for this transaction. You may download, print and retain these records and request paper copies without charge. Future edits do not replace the records you signed. Agreement acceptance, payment and installation completion are separate events. No redirect, scrolling action or Stripe payment alone is a signature or acceptance. This agreement contains no forced marketing consent or blanket liability waiver and does not limit rights under applicable law.

signatureNotice: You, the buyer, may cancel this transaction at any time prior to midnight of the third business day after the date of this transaction. See the attached Notice of Cancellation form for an explanation of this right.
ncNotice:
NORTH CAROLINA HOME-SOLICITATION CANCELLATION RIGHTS

This nonproduction transaction is treated as covered by North Carolina and federal cancellation protections without assuming a credit-sale exemption. You may cancel without penalty or obligation before midnight of the third business day after signing. The two separate completed cancellation notices identify the seller, seller's mailing address and your cancellation deadline. Home2Smart voluntarily extends the federal minimum by excluding Saturdays, Sundays and actual and observed federal holidays when calculating the printed deadline. You may cancel through the printed later deadline. This is a customer-protective contractual extension, not a claim that North Carolina law defines business days this way. An electronic signature or deposit does not waive these rights.
